posts.title: AI Can Make You Smarter Or It Can Make You Stupid
posts.description: I use artificial intelligence almost every day. It's remarkable technology. It helps me research, solve problems, and explore new ideas. Frankly, I'm amazed by what it can do. Maybe you are the same way. But I have a concern. AI can make a smart person smarter.
